code_samples.title: Execution router
code_samples.content:
# Degen-fast directional (SOLDEGEN 314): keeper TP/SL at open, bot entry-only.
# Load via run-directional-follow-degen-fast.sh

[execution_router]
mode = "dryrun"
execution_enabled = true
kill_switch = false
allow_live = false
wealth_usdc = [redacted]
min_delta_usd = 1.0
min_delta_mode = "fractional"
min_delta_frac = 0.05
per_venue_cap_usd = 6.0
open_signal_cap_usd = 6.0
open_collateral_cap_usd = 6.0
max_concurrent_open_legs = 1
open_leg_selection = "strongest_r_hat"
max_open_fee_frac_of_collateral = 0.20
min_liq_distance_bps = 150
protective_exit_bypass_reduce_cap = true
per_venue_reduce_cap_usd = 6.0
opportunity_rotation_enabled = false
opportunity_rotation_r_hat_margin = 0.0
max_orders_per_venue_per_minute = 6
rebalance_cooldown_ms = 0
rebalance_force_threshold_frac = 0.12
trailing_stop_enabled = false
trailing_stop_frac = 0.05
rebalance_policy = "directional_follow"
directional_r_hat_open = 6e-6
directional_r_hat_flip = 12e-6
directional_min_hold_ticks = 5
directional_post_flip_cooldown_ticks = 0
directional_close_settle_polls = 5
directional_profit_lock_r = 0.0
directional_profit_flip_relief_r = 0.0
directional_disaster_sl_at_open = false
directional_sl_liq_buffer_bps = 40
allowed_venues = ["gains_gtrade"]
execution_audit_ndjson_path = "./[path redacted]"
equity_live_enabled = true
wealth_usdc_cap = [redacted]

[execution_router.gains_market_costs]
enabled = true
telemetry_only = true
cache_ttl_ms = 60000
log_crowded_side_bps = 10.0
log_borrowing_bps_per_hour = 50.0
borrow_hold_relief_bps_per_hour = 100.0
min_hold_relief_ticks = 5
flip_threshold_relief_frac = 0.85

[execution_router.degen_lane]
trailing_stop_enabled = false

code_samples.title: Calibration
code_samples.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Analyze |r_hat| distribution from dryrun audit NDJSON for threshold calibration.
#
# Usage:
#   calibrate-r-hat.sh [audit.ndjson]
#   calibrate-r-hat.sh --write-env [audit.ndjson]              # provisional 2.5e-5 / 7.0e-5
#   calibrate-r-hat.sh --write-env-london [audit.ndjson]  # London-validated 2.5e-4 / 7.0e-4
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../.." && pwd)"

WRITE_ENV=0
WRITE_PERCENTILES=0
WRITE_LONDON=0
NDJSON=""
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --write-env) WRITE_ENV=1 ;;
    --write-env-london) WRITE_LONDON=1; WRITE_ENV=1 ;;
    --write-env-percentiles) WRITE_PERCENTILES=1; WRITE_ENV=1 ;;
    *) NDJSON="$arg" ;;
  esac
done
NDJSON="${NDJSON:-$ROOT/[path redacted]"

PROVISIONAL_OPEN="2.5e-5"
PROVISIONAL_FLIP="7.0e-5"
LONDON_OPEN="2.5e-4"
LONDON_FLIP="7.0e-4"
ENV_OUT="${THRESHOLDS_ENV:-$ROOT/strategies/chronos-swing-v1/[path redacted]"

if [[ ! -f "$NDJSON" ]]; then
  echo "Audit file not found: $NDJSON" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "jq required" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "python3 required" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "=== r_hat calibration: $NDJSON ==="
echo ""

VALUES_FILE="$(mktemp)"
jq -r '
  inputs
  | .intent_set.forecast_panel[]?
  | .r_hat // empty
  | select(type == "number")
  | if . < 0 then -. else . end
